fusions.name: Drawstring
fusions.desc: Pulls a noose of cord tight on the target. It deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Taut Line
fusions.desc: Strings a line 5 tiles long for 5 seconds. The line deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and knocks that enemy back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Slack Net
fusions.desc: Throws up a net of cord that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Paid-Out Thread
fusions.desc: As you move, a strung thread snaps at the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 5 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
